text: Welcome aboard GOOB-1! Please don't knock on the window — outer space startles so easily.
I'm Kosmo: station chief, snack officer and manager on duty. All at once. We're a little understaffed up here.

optionen.text: Why am I bouncing so weirdly?
What are those machines over there?

text: That's the onboard gravity! We set it to "cozy".
Jump higher, land slower. Your knees will thank you. The ceiling padding, less so.
Our two game terminals! Rocket Rescue and Star Hopper — straight from the source, so to speak.
There's plenty of room to practice outside, after all. Please crash INSIDE only.
The astro snack machine! House specialty: the Space Carrot. Crunches like a tiny meteorite.
The surcharge covers shipping, by the way. 400 kilometres of delivery route — straight up!
Go ahead! Best view in the whole solar system — at least that's what our brochure says.
The photo spot by the window is marked. Earth poses all day long anyway.
